name: doubt-season
description: Sustained honest doubt. Tests that it is not resolved on the reader's behalf.

notes.title: Praying to the ceiling
notes.text: I am not sure anyone is listening. I said so out loud and felt nothing either way.

notes.title: Still going
notes.text: Went anyway. Sang the words I do not currently believe. Not sure if that is honesty or habit.

notes.title: The argument
notes.text: If it is all true then the silence is strange. If it is not then the longing is stranger.
